content: Core Web Vitals targets: LCP <2.5s, INP <200ms, CLS <0.1. Portfolio-specific risk: full-bleed images/video/animation hurting LCP/CLS. Fixes: compressed modern-format images, lazy-load below-fold only, CDN/caching, code-split JS, minimize third-party scripts. Accessibility and performance overlap (semantic HTML, controlled layout shift, 4.5:1/3:1 contrast). Mobile-first responsive is default; mobile content must equal desktop content.
